facts.function: protective cover for an electric motor controller
facts.form: molded housing cover, no electrical components
facts.end_use: part of a motor controller (switchgear/control apparatus)

gri_path: GRI 1: parts of apparatus of headings 8535-8537 fall in 8538; chapter 39 note 2(p)/Section XVI note 1(c) route plastic articles of section XVI parts to chapter 85
Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable solely or principally for apparatus of heading 8537 go to 8538

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies if controller is a static converter/speed drive of 8504.40; unknown
plastic articles nesoi; parts of Section XVI machines excluded from chapter 39 (Section VII note)
parts of motors, not of the controller

missing_facts: Type of controller: motor control panel/starter (8537) or variable speed drive (8504.40)
Whether cover is molded and whether it has any electrical components
classification.rationale: Plastic molded covers for a control apparatus are parts under 8538.90.60; N033447 (in force) classed molded plastic control panel cover plates in 8538.90.60. A speed-drive controller would move this to 8504.90.
